September 2003: CrossFit Journal Issue 13 introduces six benchmark workouts with women's names: Angie, Barbara, Chelsea, Diane, Elizabeth and Fran. Diane is 21-15-9 deadlifts (225/155 lb) and handstand push-ups. That's 45 heavy pulls and 45 HSPU. The average time is 5 to 9 minutes; elite athletes finish in under 2:00.
